summary: libheif security fixes, password storage library bug fixes, and vim update.

changes.description: HEIF and AVIF file format decoder and encoder
changes.note:
Latest security bugfix release from upstream. Changes: https://github.com/strukturag/libheif/releases/tag/v1.23.4 .

* Resolves a number of vulnerabilities.
* Splits out the FFmpeg plugin to an optional subpackage to limit main package dependencies.

changes.description: Library for storing and retrieving passwords and other secrets
changes.note:
Update to 0.21.8.2

* Allow the content type to have additional parameters [#114, !175]
* Support individually encrypted items [!174]
* Ensure we return chained up GTask [!179]
* Ensure length of DH shared secret match length of prime on GnuTLS [!170]
* file-backend: Add thread safety and file-based locking to prevent concurrent write races [!171]
* file-backend: Fix possible memory leak in error path of secret_file_backend_real_search() [!173]
* file-collection: Fix memory leaks on repeated calls [!173]
* Replace some SecretSync with a sync implementation [!108]
* Add linker version script to hide private symbols [#70, !159]
* Stop using CONST annotations on non-const fns [!176]
* secret-tool: align behavior for collection option [!164]
* secret-tool: document --collection option [#31, !164]
* meson: Put test setup behind a feature option [#101, !162]
* Several test and CI improvements [!172, !177, !178]
* Make secret_item_load_secrets_sync match async behavior [!180]
* Updated translations
